question:
**Computer Graphics - Polygon Normal and Area**

A 3D designer has four points $A(1,2,3)$, $B(4,0,6)$, $C(2,5,4)$, and $D(3,3,7)$, representing a quadrilateral surface.

(a) Find vectors $\vec{AB}$, $\vec{AC}$, and $\vec{AD}$.

(b) Compute the area of the quadrilateral (as sum of two triangles ABC and ACD).

(c) Determine if the surface is planar using vector products.
explanation:
(a)

$\vec{AB} = (4-1)\hat{i} + (0-2)\hat{j} + (6-3)\hat{k} = 3\hat{i} -2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$

$\vec{AC} = (2-1)\hat{i} + (5-2)\hat{j} + (4-3)\hat{k} = 1\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 1\hat{k}$

$\vec{AD} = (3-1)\hat{i} + (3-2)\hat{j} + (7-3)\hat{k} = 2\hat{i} + 1\hat{j} + 4\hat{k}$

(b)

Area of $\triangle ABC$:

$|\vec{AB} \times \vec{AC}|/2$

$\left|\begin{matrix}\hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 \end{matrix}\right| = \hat{i}((-2)\cdot1-3\cdot3) -\hat{j}(3\cdot1-3\cdot1)+\hat{k}(3\cdot3-(-2)\cdot1)$

$=\hat{i}(-2-9) - \hat{j}(3-3) + \hat{k}(9+2)$

$=-11\hat{i}+0\hat{j}+11\hat{k}$

$|\cdot|=\sqrt{11^2+0+11^2}=\sqrt{121+121}=\sqrt{242}$

Area $= \frac{\sqrt{242}}{2}$

Area of $\triangle ACD$:

$\vec{AC} \times \vec{AD}$

$\left|\begin{matrix}\hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 4 \end{matrix}\right|$

$=\hat{i}(3\cdot4-1\cdot1)-\hat{j}(1\cdot4-1\cdot2)+\hat{k}(1\cdot1-3\cdot2)$

$=\hat{i}(12-1)-\hat{j}(4-2)+\hat{k}(1-6)$

$=11\hat{i}-2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$

$|\cdot|=\sqrt{121+4+25}=\sqrt{150}$

Area $= \frac{\sqrt{150}}{2}$

Total quadrilateral area: $\frac{\sqrt{242}+\sqrt{150}}{2}$

(c)

If $\vec{AB} \times \vec{AC}$ and $\vec{AC} \times \vec{AD}$ are scalar multiples, surface is planar.

$\vec{n}_1=-11\hat{i}+0\hat{j}+11\hat{k}$

$\vec{n}_2=11\hat{i}-2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$

Not scalar multiples $\implies$ points are not coplanar $\implies$ surface is not perfectly planar.

options.A:
(a) $\vec{AB}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$, $\vec{AC}=\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, $\vec{AD}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$
(b) Area $=\frac{\sqrt{242}+\sqrt{150}}{2}$
(c) Surface is not perfectly planar.
options.D:
(a) $\vec{AB}=2\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$, $\vec{AC}=3\hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, $\vec{AD}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$
(b) Area $=\frac{\sqrt{150}}{2}$
(c) Surface is not perfectly planar.
